transient.Description:
Increases movement speed.
Duration: 10s (20s when not in combat)
Additional Effect: Grants Jog when the effect expires
Jog Effect: Movement speed is increased
Effect ends when enmity is generated. Has no effect in battle.
※Unavailable in PvP.
